exercises.name: Pause back squat
exercises.notes: 2-second pause at the bottom.

exercises.name: SSB squat, heels raised
exercises.notes: Heels on small plates.

exercises.name: SSB front squat (bar reversed)
exercises.notes: Bar turned round and held in front. Can press on the throat.

exercises.name: Hatfield squat
exercises.notes: SSB with hands on the safeties for balance.

exercises.name: Deficit deadlift
exercises.notes: Standing on a plate.

exercises.name: Deadlift from blocks
exercises.notes: Plates raised on blocks or stacked plates.

exercises.name: Trap bar deficit deadlift
exercises.notes: Standing on a plate.

exercises.name: Back extension, hip-led (flat back)
exercises.notes: Back stays flat; the movement comes from the hips.

exercises.name: Back extension, spinal (rounding through)
exercises.notes: Curl down and up through the spine. Not for an irritated back.

exercises.name: Back extension, 2-second hold at the top
Back extension, plate held at chest
exercises.notes: Load is the plate weight.

exercises.name: Back extension, plate behind head
exercises.notes: Harder than holding the same plate at the chest.

exercises.name: Back extension, dumbbell held at chest
Back extension, banded
exercises.notes: Band anchored under the bench, over the neck or held at the chest.

exercises.name: Back extension, single leg, plate at chest
Nordic curl
exercises.notes: Feet anchored in the GHD.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.notes: Toes on a plate for range.

exercises.name: Push-up, hands raised
exercises.notes: Hands on a bench or bar in the rack. Easier the higher the hands.

exercises.name: Weighted dip
exercises.notes: Load is the added weight on the belt.

exercises.name: Landmine press
exercises.notes: Load is the plates on the bar. Can be done one arm or two.

exercises.name: Landmine press, parallel handle
exercises.notes: Two hands on the M3 handle, neutral grip. Load is the plates on the bar.

exercises.name: Weighted pull-up
exercises.notes: Load is the added weight on the belt.

exercises.name: Pull-up negative
exercises.notes: Jump to the top, lower for 3 to 5 seconds.

exercises.name: Landmine row (T-bar)
exercises.notes: Load is the plates on the bar. Neutral grip with the M3 handle.

exercises.name: Inverted row
exercises.notes: Bar set in the rack. Higher bar is easier.

exercises.name: DB curl on the ABX curl attachment
McGill curl-up
exercises.notes: Count holds rather than reps if preferred.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.notes: Resists twisting, without twisting.

exercises.name: GHD sit-up
exercises.notes: Loaded extension at the bottom. Not for an irritated back.

exercises.name: Boxing bag, straight punches only
exercises.notes: No hooks or body rotation.

exercises.name: Walk
exercises.notes: Logged in minutes.

exercises.name: Ruck walk
exercises.notes: Weighted rucksack. Log the pack weight as the load.

exercises.name: Sandbag to shoulder
exercises.notes: Load is the sandbag's current weight. Rounded-back lift by design.

exercises.name: Farmer's carry, loadable handles
exercises.notes: For loads above the 50kg dumbbells. Load includes the handle.

exercises.name: Ring row
exercises.notes: Feet further forward is harder.

exercises.name: Ring fallout
exercises.notes: Anti-extension. Shorter range is easier.

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.notes: Hold the rack for balance if needed.

exercises.name: Side-lying open book
exercises.notes: Upper back rotation with the knees stacked.

exercises.name: Seated sciatic nerve slider
exercises.notes: Easy range. Look up as the knee straightens.
